text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The meeting between King Hussein and President Arafat has been "renewed on the land of liberated Palestine."
- Arafat says "we do not ask for the impossible...only the implementation of accords on the ground and we welcome an international presence to solve the security problem."

- Prime Minister Kabariti briefed cabinet on the results of the Hussein-Arafat meeting, a letter from the king to Egyptian President Mubarak to be delivered by the prime minster during his visit to Cairo on Wednesday.
- A tumultuous popular reception for King Hussein in "Palestine"...king says: "I am happy to be with you on the soil of your state and will support you with our utmost capability."
- A historic visit by King Hussein, total support to Palestinians, Palestinian officials say: "Jordan is the real support for Palestinian people."
- King pays landmark visit to Jericho in emphatic expression of support for Palestinians.
- King meets leader of Algerian Islamic Society.

- King Hussein says: "we saw the tidings of an independent Palestinian state,"... Arafat says: "in the name of the Palestinian twin thank you your majesty from our hearts and we will not forget your blessed efforts."
- Twelve investment opportunities in the tourism sector at a cost of $193 million, says the investment promotion board.
- French President Chirac meets deputies and senators in parliament during his coming visit to Jordan.
- U.N. Iraq Gulf War compensation claims to be paid before next year.
- EU's trioka visits Jordan as part of a regional tour.
